//overrides: One React, everywhere. Excalidraw depends on @radix-ui/* whose peer ranges still
stop at React 18, so npm installed a second React at the root to satisfy them —
and two copies of React in one tree break reconciliation. It surfaced as
'Objects are not valid as a React child' across seventeen unrelated tests, green
locally and red under `npm ci`, because only a clean install produces the broken
layout. Radix works with React 19; the peer range is stale, not a real bound.
The rest are npm audit fixes for packages pinned by a dependency, so no range
update can reach them. Excalidraw pins nanoid 3.3.3 and its mermaid plugin pins
4.0.2; every 4.x is affected, so the plugin moves to 5, and both only call
nanoid(), which is unchanged across 3-5. chevrotain pins lodash-es 4.17.21,
mermaid caps katex below the fixed 0.19 (it only calls renderToString), and
vitest's vite is dev-only. Drop each entry once its parent ships the fix.
